cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb:
Step into a welcoming Houston kitchen and explore the flavors of refined Italian cooking in this interactive class hosted through Cozymeal. With a maximum of 8 guests, this intimate session highlights timeless techniques across a four-course menu.

The menu you will prepare includes:

- Starter: Zuppa Toscana with sausage, kale and potatoes
- Main course: Chicken marsala with a rich wine sauce and risotto
- Side dishes: Garlic-sautéed broccolini and carrots
- Dessert: Lemon cream cake with layers of citrus cream

With guidance from your local chef, you’ll gain confidence in crafting Italian sauces, risotto and vegetables with finesse. Guests are welcome to bring wine or beer to enjoy with the meal, making this both an educational and celebratory culinary evening.
